dimensions.name: D3 Dosage Clarity
dimensions.description: Is the D3 dosage clearly stated in both IU and mcg with daily value percentage?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No dosage. 3: IU only. 5: IU + mcg. 7: Full dosage with %DV. 10: Dosage with %DV, context for deficiency levels, and dosing guidance.

dimensions.name: K2 Form Specificity
dimensions.description: Is the K2 form specified (MK-7 vs MK-4) with sourcing and dosage?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No K2 detail. 3: Just 'K2'. 5: MK-7 or MK-4 named. 7: Form named with mcg dosage. 10: Form specified with sourcing (natto-derived), dosage, and explanation of MK-7 superiority.

dimensions.name: Source Transparency
dimensions.description: Is the D3 source disclosed (lanolin, lichen for vegan, cholecalciferol)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No source. 3: 'Vitamin D3'. 5: 'Cholecalciferol'. 7: Source named (lanolin or lichen). 10: Full sourcing with vegan/non-vegan distinction and rationale.

dimensions.name: Absorption Enhancement
dimensions.description: Is oil-based formula, MCT oil, or fat-soluble absorption strategy mentioned?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No mention. 3: Vague 'enhanced absorption'. 5: Oil-based noted. 7: Specific oil carrier (MCT, olive, coconut). 10: Oil carrier + explanation of why D3/K2 need fat for absorption.

dimensions.name: Synergy Explanation
dimensions.description: Is the D3+K2 synergy explained (calcium direction, bone/heart health)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No synergy mention. 3: 'D3 and K2 together'. 5: Basic synergy claim. 7: Explains calcium metabolism. 10: Full synergy explanation — D3 absorbs calcium, K2 directs it to bones not arteries.

dimensions.name: Use-Case Positioning
dimensions.description: Are specific outcomes targeted (bone health, immune support, mood, cardiovascular)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No outcomes. 3: Generic 'health'. 5: One outcome. 7: 2-3 outcomes. 10: Multiple outcomes with audience-specific context.

dimensions.name: Allergen & Dietary Callouts
dimensions.description: Are vegan, gluten-free, soy-free, non-GMO stated?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None. 5: Some callouts. 10: Comprehensive with vegan sourcing clarity.

dimensions.name: Third-Party Testing
dimensions.description: Are third-party testing, USP, NSF certifications mentioned?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None. 5: Basic testing claim. 10: Multiple certifications with specifics.

dimensions.name: Keyword Coverage
dimensions.description: Does the listing include category-relevant search terms?

dimensions.name: Trust Signals
dimensions.description: Are GMP, made in USA, doctor-recommended signals present?
